lists.about: Uptrend checklist: price above its 50, 150 and 200-day averages, 50 above 150 above 200, the 200-day rising for a month, at least 30% above the 52-week low, within 25% of the 52-week high, and RS rating 70 or more.
Stock moved into a Stage 2 uptrend in the last 10 sessions after basing or falling. Stage uses the 50, 120 and 200-day averages.
RS rating 80 or more and up at least 10 points in a month: the stock is beating more of the market than it did.

lists.n: RS line at a new high before price
lists.about: Price compared with the Nifty 500 is at a 52-week high, while the price itself is still 5% or more under its own 52-week high.

Uptrend stock resting 0 to 3% under its resistance level (the highest high of the last 60 sessions, leaving out the last 3), base no deeper than 25%. The line is drawn on the chart. A level to watch, not an entry.
After a rise of 20% or more, the last 20 sessions stayed inside a 15% range, price above its 50-day average.
After a 30%+ rise, the last 6 weeks stayed inside an 18% range, price above its 200-day average.
The last 45 sessions in three parts: each part swung less than the one before, the last under 8%, volume of the last 10 days under 80% of its 50-day average, price above the 50-day average.
At least 3 of the last 5 sessions had a range under 60% of the stock's usual daily range, price above its 20-day average, 50-day average above the 200-day.
Up 15% or more in 3 months; today's low came within 1.5% of the rising 20-day average and the close held above it.
Up 25% or more in 6 months but flat in the last month; today's low came within 1.5% of the 50-day average and the close held above it.
In the last 3 sessions the stock dipped under its 20-day low and closed back above it the same day, while above its 200-day average.
Up 4% or more today on more volume than yesterday and at least 1.5 times the 50-day average, Rs 5 crore+ traded.
Closed above its resistance level (highest high of the 60 sessions before) in the last 5 sessions on 1.5 times normal volume, and still above it.

lists.n: Biggest volume in a quarter or more (up day)
lists.about: Today's volume was the highest in at least 63 sessions (a quarter), 252 sessions (a year) or the whole 4 years we hold, on an up day.
Up day with more volume than any down day of the last 10 sessions, price above its 50-day average.
Fell 3% or more under yesterday's close during the day, then closed 1% or more above it, on 1.5 times normal volume.
Closed above every close of the past year, Rs 1 crore+ traded a day.
In the last 10 sessions the first session after a results filing opened 3% or more above the previous close, closed at or above its open, and the price is still above that day's low.
In the last 10 sessions the first session after a results filing closed 8% or more up on at least 3 times normal volume.
Latest quarter (filed in the last 120 days): earnings per share up 100% or more on the year, sales up 20% or more, and the year-ago quarter was in profit.
Growth in earnings per share, sales and the profit margin each rose for 3 quarters in a row (latest filed in the last 120 days).
Earnings per share growth of 25%+ this quarter, higher than last quarter's (which was also positive), sales up 15%+.
The year-ago quarter was a loss, the latest quarter (filed in the last 120 days) a profit, with sales growing.
Gained 25% or more in the last 21 sessions, Rs 2 crore+ traded a day.
Gained 50% or more in the last 63 sessions, Rs 2 crore+ traded a day.
Up 100% or more in the last 126 sessions, Rs 2 crore+ traded a day.
Listed in the last 12 months and trading within 15% of the highest price since listing.
NSE's own list of stocks that touched their upper price band today (liquid stocks only). 'Locked' = also closed at the band. Days in a row counts the sessions it hit the upper band running.
NSE's own list of stocks that touched their lower price band today (liquid stocks only). 'Locked' = also closed at the band. Days in a row counts the sessions it hit the lower band running.
